patient_dict.Facility Name: New York - Presbyterian Brooklyn Methodist Hospital
patient_dict.APR MDC Description: DISEASES AND DISORDERS OF THE RESPIRATORY SYSTEM

llm_response: Based on the analysis of key factors influencing healthcare costs and the predicted cost impact of suggested strategies, the final recommended strategies are: 1) Optimize facility selection to utilize cost-efficient providers without compromising quality. 2) Reduce length of stay through enhanced care coordination and discharge planning to decrease unnecessary inpatient days. 3) Evaluate the necessity and explore alternatives for high-cost procedures to avoid excessive expenditure. 4) Tailor preventive care programs for specific age groups to reduce hospital admissions and complications. 5) Increase scheduled admissions over emergency admissions to improve resource planning and reduce costs. 6) Improve community care access to reduce emergency department visits and associated costs. 7) Adopt minimally invasive surgical protocols and standardized clinical pathways to improve outcomes and reduce variability in care costs. Implementing these strategies is expected to lower inpatient healthcare costs while maintaining or improving care quality.
